name: 01850 · Lowell, MA
findings: ZIP 01850 (Lowell) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01850 (Lowell) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
